title: The Voices Beneath the Water

source.note: Original fan adventure requested by David for Jonathan; no source novel or real-person likeness.
source.nextStart: Jon offers an overconfident demonstration at the temporary class. A teacher helps him turn a confusing exercise into a useful test of how people learn: simple physical models, translated labels, and a short illustrated story with a bear's paw and a wolf. His awkward demonstration earns a laugh; he learns to ask what the learners need rather than show what he knows.
source.nextEndBefore: Preserve all memory fields, water totals, allocation agreements, deaths, injuries and equipment losses. Keep one shared plot.
source.continuationNote: Follow approved vocabulary plan; actual target coverage audited across all routes.

completed.end: Jonathan escorts the child home safely. Her mother stands beside them while her voice repeats from the closed water store. Q records the sound; its cause remains unknown.

stagingRevision.note: Q remains visible for his later lines; original text, audio, choices and released v1 bytes preserved.

completed.end: Neri water emergency resolved with four material outcomes and two independent truth/cooperation outcomes. Tao or Q may die, or all survive with half/no shipment. No universal outcome selected.

Two-community water negotiation ends in hill control, temporary need-based distribution, or earned shared management. Mei survives only with evacuation or treatment. Earlier casualties and An’s independent testimony persist.

Jonathan and An isolate the damaged pipe and return unharmed. Player recovers a sample, a copied route, or both by abandoning the anchored rope. Prior survivors, promises, agreement and stored water persist in the confirmed continuity snapshot. Jonathan learns to respect An’s stop signal and expertise.

Western station expedition completed. Both return safely; stored water and prior continuity unchanged. Player either takes part by draining empty lower archive (door/records lost), leaves part preserving door/records, or after inspection braces with retained rope / destroys lightsaber if rope lost, preserving records temporarily and committing to repair before next storm. Recovered part repairs home pipe but valve stays closed. Sample routes show unsafe water; no-sample route remains untested.

Episode 6 repairs station door using new spare plate, keeps destroyed archive/equipment gone and home pipe unchanged. Both alive; lift: An uninjured, warning unsent, beacon intact; signal: warning sent, An arm injured and cannot climb/lift; relay after inspect: warning sent, An safe, beacon circuit permanently lost. Stored drinking water unchanged. Upper relay next.

Episode 7 separately discovers recorded water requests routed through dry pipes. Mother never consented to replay; child safe offstage. Destroy loses relay records; preserve leaves playback risk and recorded dissent; isolate requires consenting voice test AND retained station archive, stops playback and retains records. An injury persists; burned beacon prevents transmission. No water or past losses restored. Eastern manual request next; operator and deep reserve unknown.

Ren admits ordering recorded pleas to repeat because nobody answered. Episode 8: take removes eastern key, blocking old playback requests and new help calls; trust leaves key with Ren, old playback switched off but restart risk remains; shared requires inspection/test, locks old-request switch with Jonathan holding its key while new help calls remain live and Jonathan/An provide interim oversight pending a willing second operator. Ren commits to personal account; written statement optional, no assumed forgiveness. An injury/beacon and all earlier losses, water totals and records remain unchanged. Ren denies controlling western water flow; deep reserve unknown.

Ren personally accounts to Mother without obtaining forgiveness. Eastern key ownership and old-playback state unchanged; take uses a doorstep message point, trust retains Ren’s control under public scrutiny, shared gains Mother’s explicit one-shift consent and trained oversight. Min admits the western bypass serves a separate external cooling pipes for the sick shelter. Finite surface cistern feeds it by gravity; local underground cistern empty, no secret drinkable reserve. All routes close the failing bypass, preserve losses and water totals, and commit to restoring the town supply together at dawn. One main storyline henceforth; choices remembered, not multiplying plot branches.
Misaligned new joint is seated correctly with supports, dry repair completed; valves remain closed and no water is added or used.

Independent retest with sound equipment confirms isolated line holds. Pipe still needs cleaning and water-quality clearance. Separately sealed, inspected ship delivery adds two buckets to actual stored drinking water on every route.

Fresh correctly labelled samples pass the trained ship crew’s full drinking-water clearance after the prescribed wait; repaired line remains isolated until controlled transfer. Stored water unchanged.

Exactly four new measured buckets enter storage through the cleared pipe, old total +4. Old allocation agreements retained; no distribution yet. Min volunteers for the delivery work without requesting forgiveness.
All four buckets reach the designated recipients under the existing allocation agreement; undistributed stock decreases by exactly four. Min accepts shared help. They return to prepare the intake.
New cover and straps secured and checked before dangerous wind; all three withdraw indoors unharmed. Water and prior losses unchanged; agree to inspect after the weather passes.

Protection inspected and holding; no stock changed. Learning-centre roof visibly unstable, remains closed. Qualified repair/inspection arranged; safe interim meeting space available, teacher Sela invited to plan temporary lessons.

Separate temporary learning courtyard inspected and ready. Teacher Sela and parent Ivo agree that the son may visit, speak privately and choose companionship; Ivo will ask him rather than assume consent. Main centre still needs roof repair; all old memory/water unchanged.

defaults.language: Short simplified Mandarin, contextual interlinear pinyin and cached audio. Screenshot membership is not reading mastery.
defaults.coverageNote: New learner: no assessed-known export. The 80% floor measures membership only in the supplied inventory plus proposed glossary, not mastery. All additional basic scaffolding is annotated and audited privately; never promote it to familiar to pass a check.
defaults.teaserArtwork: ImageGen first, then video. Use Jon’s approved likeness reference; shonen-anime Jedi art is welcome (David, 2026-10-26). Keep generated video at or below $0.15 total per clip, including retries.
defaults.choiceConsequences: From Episode 9 onward, preserve memory of previous choices and material losses, but keep one main storyline. Use local expressive choices and callbacks that rejoin the shared plot. Do not multiply permanent narrative branches.
defaults.teaserDialogue: Every opening teaser includes one cool or epic spoken English phrase by Jon or another character, foreshadowing the highest-tension moment. ImageGen first; exact words once, no extra speech. User preference 2026-10-27.

Jonathan, An and Q travel to Neri for water; Min is an adult with an ill wife; Tao is the pump worker.
Episode 2 has four outcomes: Tao dead/all water/Q alive; everyone alive/half water; everyone alive/no water/Tao offers a lead; Tao alive/all water/Q destroyed and recording lost.
An agrees to answer publicly alongside Jonathan if he tells the truth; she refuses to support concealment and gives her own account.
The source of the repeated voice remains unexplained. Do not resurrect Tao or Q or restore the lost recording without an explicitly selected compatible route.

Episode 3: three preparations from pump inspection, both-community hearing, voluntary household reserve contribution and evacuation. Shared management requires inspection and hearing and costs four buckets.
Mei survives only if evacuated early or treated with four buckets; otherwise she dies. Do not resurrect her.
Hill control costs six buckets; emergency distribution breaks a prior promise if made; shared management renegotiates it by consent. Carry the actual agreement and remaining water forward.
Episode 4 confirms a valid Episode 3 continuity snapshot before play; it preserves exact drinking water, earlier deaths, agreement, promise and An’s previous testimony.
Jonathan and An return from the crack unharmed after isolating a damaged western pipe. Its sample is for testing, never drinking supply.
